title: Tensor vanishing in one degree under an open immersion
statement: Let $j:X\to Y$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with independently chosen derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $R$ be an additive exact functor from module sheaves on $Y$ to those on $X$, naturally isomorphic to ordinary restriction along $j$ [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits]. For $E\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$ and any integer $i$, assume that $H^i(E\otimes^{\mathbf L}H)=0$ for every module sheaf $H$ on $Y$, in [def-pc-derived-tensor-cohomology-vanishes]. Then $H^i(R_D(E)\otimes^{\mathbf L}G)=0$ for every module sheaf $G$ on $X$, where $R_D$ is the exact functor induced on derived categories.

source.place: Open-immersion specialization, degreewise direct-image testing argument

proof.text: For a test sheaf G on X apply h to the ordinary direct image j_*G. Unpack the K-flat representative P, its Q isomorphism, and its zero tensor homology. Use isKFlat_restrict and transport along the natural isomorphism R ≅ restrictFunctor j to make R(P) K-flat. Compose the exact functor mapDerivedCategoryFactors comparison with R_D applied to the representing isomorphism.

Transport Scheme.Modules.pullbackMonoidal along R ≅ restrictFunctor j ≅ pullback j. Restriction preserves all coproducts by its left adjunction. HomologicalComplex₂.mapTotalIso and the natural tensorators give the total tensor complex comparison, including its signed differentials. Exact R sends zero homology to zero by mapHomologyIso. The open-immersion adjunction counit and singleMapHomologicalComplex identify R(j_*G[0]) with G[0]. Transport this zero homology to the tensor of R(P) with G[0].

lean.statement:
theorem openImmersion_tensor_vanishing {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion j]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wU} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wF} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (R : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (eR : Nonempty (R ≅ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j))
    [R.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits R] [PreservesFiniteColimits R]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (i : ℤ)
    (h : ∀ H : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace),
      schemeDerivedTensorCohomologyVanishes Y E H i) :
    ∀ H : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace),
      schemeDerivedTensorCohomologyVanishes X
        (R.mapDerivedCategory.obj E) H i
